summary: Iteration 8 covers the TapCTA sweep, new /careers page end-to-end, Vision 4-stage roadmap, and SEO regression. Backend pytest 17/17 pass (added TestCareers class with 4 cases: valid+persistence, short-message rejection, invalid email, honeypot). Frontend verified live: /careers renders hero, 4 culture cards (careers-culture-1..4), 3 role cards with correct testids (career-role-saas-sales-intern / -us-markets-intern / -uk-markets-intern) each showing 'Unpaid internship · 4 months' and correct PPO line; JSON-LD graph has 3 JobPostings + 1 FAQPage; canonical=https://www.fluxvex.com/careers; unique title. 'Text us to apply' on US role preselects careers-role-select to saas-sales-us-markets-intern and scrolls to apply section. Invalid short message triggers careers-error with backend copy 'Tell us a little more—why do you want to join Fluxvex? (at least 20 characters)'. Valid submission shows careers-success and persists in Mongo. TapCTA sweep: nav-join-waitlist-button, nav-join-waitlist-mobile-button, nav-contact-link, final-cta-join-waitlist-button, final-cta-explore-pricing-link, workflow-cta-button, platform-cta-button, affiliate-cta-button, vision-cta-button, plan-card-starter-cta, plan-card-growth-cta, integration-cta-button, integration-bottom-cta-button, blog-post-cta-button, security-page-contact-link, waitlist-submit-button, careers-submit-button, career-apply-<slug> — ALL resolve to real DOM elements (testid prop → data-testid attr via TapCTA works). Nav Contact navigates to /contact. Vision roadmap: all 4 cards present (reporting/proposals/invoicing/ai-account-manager); AI block has exactly 2 vision-ai-capability + 3 vision-ai-capability-future (correct for new 5-capability layout). Waitlist end-to-end: submit via navbar waitlist-submit-button (motion.button) → POST /api/waitlist → waitlist-success element with 'You're on the list.' Mongo-persisted. Sections mega menu opens on hover with mega-item-* children. SEO: /sitemap.xml = 21 <loc>s incl. /careers, 3 /integrations/*, 12 /blog/*; /llms.txt includes the SaaS sales careers line. Mobile 390px zero horizontal overflow on /, /careers, /integrations/google-ads, /blog. Zero console errors across /, /careers, /blog, /integrations/google-ads.

integration_issues.issue: The spec claims 'plan CTA opens waitlist with interest preselected'. In practice openWaitlist() in WaitlistContext accepts only a `from` string and does NOT consume the plan's interest. The modal's Plan interest select stays at the default 'Not sure yet' regardless of which plan CTA was clicked. PricingPreview defines interest: 'Starter'/'Growth' on each plan but never forwards it. Minor UX gap, not a crash.

action_items: (OPTIONAL) Wire interest preselect through openWaitlist(source, { interest }) and have PricingPreview pass the plan's interest, so plan CTAs preselect waitlist-interest-select to 'Starter' or 'Growth'. Currently that review-stated behavior is not implemented but no error occurs.
critical_code_review_comments: TapCTA correctly maps the custom `testid` prop onto data-testid; after conversion every CTA across Navbar/Footer/HowItWorks/Platform/PricingPreview/Affiliate/Vision/FinalCta/Integration/BlogPost/Security/SecuritySection/WaitlistContext/Careers still exposes its original testid. No regression here.

WaitlistContext.openWaitlist(from) signature doesn't accept preselect metadata — if plan interest preselect is a product requirement, extend to openWaitlist(from, overrides) and merge into initial form state.

Careers backend POST /api/careers correctly validates (name, EMAIL_RE, role length, message>=20 chars, <=5000), honeypot `trap` short-circuits, rate limiting shared with waitlist/contact. Response matches frontend error-copy expectation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on required checks; 1 non-blocking integration gap (plan interest preselect not implemented)

seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed career_applications + waitlist UI records (one real careers application via UI with ui_test_<ts>@testflix.dev + one waitlist with test_wl_<ts>@testflix.dev + test_cta_<ts>@testflix.dev) persist in Mongo; pytest-created rows self-cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest now 17/17; sitemap expectation remains 21 URLs. Careers endpoint lives at POST /api/careers (name/email/role/portfolio/message/trap, message min 20 chars). Nav waitlist CTA testid is `nav-join-waitlist-button` (not `nav-waitlist-cta`). Plan CTA testids are `plan-card-{starter|growth}-cta` on the HOME page's PricingPreview — the standalone /pricing page uses different components. WaitlistContext success element testid is `waitlist-success`. The known gap: openWaitlist does not propagate plan interest to the modal.
